shows.title: The Pass
shows.venue: Ellen Stewart Theatre at La MaMa

shows.title: The Wind in the Willows - Theatre On Kew
shows.description: Celebrate a special milestone, as this year marks the 40th Anniversary of Glenn Elston's adaptation of The Wind in the Willows. Join Ratty, Mole, Badger, Otter, and, of course, the arrogant, and hilarious Mr Toad as they get up to some riverbank mischief. With laughs and surprises for everyone, this is interactive theatre at its best.

shows.title: The Animals Come to the Table - Globe
shows.description: A negotiator and an interpreter are called to a secret emergency meeting. Waiting for them are a chicken, a rat, a snow leopard and an army of voices from the natural world demanding an end to exploitation and ecological destruction.

shows.title: King John - Globe
shows.description: Desperate to carve out an identity of his own to escape the shadow of his adored older brother, King John must step into the role he claims the right to and attempt to rule his England.

shows.title: The Seagull - Globe
shows.description: What begins as a play within a play soon becomes a gripping tale of art, ego and love. And, when the curtain falls, what is really left behind?

shows.title: The Traitors: Live Experience
shows.description:
Are you a Faithful or a Traitor?
Step inside the world of The Traitors and play the official live experience in Covent Garden. Complete missions, take your seat at The Round Table, build alliances and uncover hidden Traitors in a thrilling game of strategy, deception and trust. Will you survive as a Faithful or triumph as a Traitor? Just remember, even your closest ally could be your most dangerous enemy…

shows.title: Julius Caesar - Globe
shows.description: In the corridors of the Senate, a murderous plot builds amidst concerns over the growing ambition of dictator Julius Caesar. But when the tide of public opinion turns against his enemies, political in-fighting unfolds into civil war…

shows.title: Jack and the Beanstalk - Theatre on Kew
shows.description:
Presented in a relaxed picnic theatre style, the delightfully interactive
pantomime Jack and the Beanstalk invites audiences of all ages to join in
the adventure. Giggle at the Goose on the Loose, hunt for the Golden
Eggs, sing along with Daisy the Cow, and help Jack defeat the Giant once
and for all!

shows.title: Sacrilegious
shows.description:
On the holiest day of the year, an idealistic young rabbi does the one thing nobody saw
coming – he dares to challenge the billionaire president of his congregation, questions a
multi-million-dollar donation, and ignites a battle for the hearts and minds of the entire
community.

shows.title: Shrek's Adventure! London Standard Entry
shows.description: Step into and star in your very own hilarious, mad-cap adventure to the kingdom of Far Far Away
